name: send-evidence
description: Transfer real file bytes or structured report through damaged radio.

request_format.encoding: JSON object passed as the --request argument
request_format.fields: artifact_id for bytes, or data for a structured report; destination; optional route. A confirmed report uses data.observation_verdict="confirmed", data.first/data.second={frame_id,detection_id}, and data.evidence_transfer.message_id from this task’s completed send. The wrapper recalculates verification and exclusion geometry from both real frames and requires the transferred original/crop to contain a verified detection. A delivery_verified report must reference the package_id already verified by the local payload ledger.

completion.poll: status_flag with the returned request ID
